_meta.source: UN Comtrade Plus (comtradeapi.un.org, authenticated data/v1/get) — HS6, 2025 where reported, else 2024
_meta.notes: Each importer-commodity carries its own 'year': 2025 when that year's answer was complete, otherwise 2024 (pairs this run: 2024: 30, 2025: 159). Top 5 suppliers per importer-commodity. ~25 priority importers (free-tier quota). Endpoint: authenticated data/v1/get (COMTRADE_API_KEY), one call per importer. Succeeded: 30/29, re-queued: 2, skipped: 0. Coverage this run: 19 importers / 189 importer-commodity pairs (previous file: 19 / 189). Rate-limited (429) calls are re-queued up to 3 times rather than dropped, and a coverage regression caused by failed calls keeps the previous file instead of overwriting it. v45: values count Comtrade aggregate rows only (motCode=0 AND partner2Code=0). The public-preview endpoint also returns per-transport-mode and per-second-partner copies of the same trade; summing all rows overstated USD totals for a subset of importers by ~3-11x (GBR 4.00x, DEU 3.05x, ESP ~11x; EGY/ITA/NLD were unaffected). Dropped 52035 breakout rows this run. Values are raw USD despite the legacy usd_m / total_usd_m field names.
